text: The Vice President of Finance and Administration, TO Live will give a presentation on the 2020 staffing budget.

The Human Resources Compensation and Labour Relations Committee recommends that the Board of Directors of TO Live: 1. Approve the 2020 Staffing Budget, as outlined in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (May 24, 2019) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, TO Live, subject to the report from the President and Chief Executive Officer to the Audit Committee. 2. Direct that the confidential information contained in Confidential Attachments 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 to the report (May 24, 2019) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, TO Live remain confidential in its entirety, as it pertains to labour relations or employee negotiations.
